title: One leaf sub-question of a 9618 past paper (one line of corpus/rows/p<N>/<paper>.jsonl)

id.description: <paper>:<question label down to the finest level>, e.g. 9618_s24_22:3(b)(ii)

command_word.description: Leading command phrase, e.g. Explain / State / Write program code / Complete

stem.description: The leaf's own text from the QP

stem_ctx.description: Parent context needed to understand the leaf (shared scenario, earlier parts' givens); may be empty

qp_page.description: 1-based page in the QP PDF where the leaf starts

ms_page.description: 1-based page in the MS PDF where the leaf's MS entry starts

ms_text.description: Raw MS answer text for exactly this leaf (layout-preserved where it matters)

has_figure.description: True when a diagram/table/code listing in the QP matters to the answer: always consult the PDF page

equivalent_of.description: Row id of an identical earlier leaf (duplicate variant), else null

extension.description: True for 2021 (extension corpus); excluded from stats/priority

types.description: Added by tagging tasks (T24/T34). Absent until then.

tag_confidence.description: Added with types; low = needs design-agent adjudication

tag_note.description: Why confidence is low / adjudication note

markpoints.description: P2/P4 coding leaves with marks >= 4: the MS split into individually credited points (T24/T34)

text.description: Verbatim MS wording of this point

ms_max.description: When the MS lists more points than marks ('Max 4'), the cap

er.description: Examiner-report excerpt for this leaf (T27); for 易错 only, never a scoring source
